title: Phone menus: ten Single Player modes fit, and a menu freeze is fixed
summary: Single Player's ten modes now fit a 390x844 portrait phone (the stage above the list shrinks); on shorter Safari screens the list scrolls and the last mode scrolls into view above Back.
details: Fixed a freeze: after a failed ride load, the shared garage preview pipeline stayed tied to the old GPU device and the next menu page crashed; it is now released with the GPU.
Scroll: lifting a finger after a fast flick now keeps its momentum.
Two stale tests were corrected: an old six-mode assumption, and a divider check that mistook row labels for the rim.
Verification: menu_flows, menu_phone_layout and menu_divider pass on the host build; menu_scroll passed 1 of 2 (timing-sensitive, #707).
limitation: Host Chromium/WebKit only; no physical phone.
caption: Single Player at 390x844 portrait with all ten modes
